changes.to: Maker page (checked 2026-11-22) calls QDH an upper-body humanoid platform that can be paired with different mobility bases, a completed predecessor to Apollo; it publishes no height, weight, payload, DoF or runtime. Third-party figures (14 DoF, 165 cm, 73 kg) were not added. Kept as a legged research platform per Apptronik's own description as a bipedal mobility platform in its 2023 post.
Apptronik's Quick Development Humanoid, an early upper-body humanoid platform that preceded Apollo.
